events.name: doc.command_panicked
events.summary: A command panicked; its transaction was rolled back

events.name: doc.patched
events.summary: The live document changed; apply `ops` to the document at `prev_rev`

events.name: doc.reset
events.summary: The document changed in a way ops cannot express; resync from a snapshot

events.name: tx.closed
events.summary: A transaction ended and released its soft locks

events.name: tx.locked
events.summary: A gesture or proposal soft-locked more items

events.name: tx.opened
events.summary: A transaction was opened (no items locked yet)
